mapper.select: SELECT lifecycle_base_profile_id, user_id, monthly_living_expense, current_housing_type, current_monthly_housing_expense AS monthly_housing_expense, industry_code, salary_growth_scenario, custom_salary_growth_rate, created_at, updated_at FROM lifecycle_base_profile WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lifecycle_base_profile ( user_id, monthly_living_expense, current_housing_type, current_monthly_housing_expense, industry_code, salary_growth_scenario, custom_salary_growth_rate ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{request.monthlyLivingExpense}, #{request.currentHousingType}, #{request.monthlyHousingExpense}, #{request.industryCode}, #{request.salaryGrowthScenario}, #{request.customSalaryGrowthRate} )
mapper.update: UPDATE lifecycle_base_profile SET monthly_living_expense = #{request.monthlyLivingExpense}, current_housing_type = #{request.currentHousingType}, current_monthly_housing_expense = #{request.monthlyHousingExpense}, industry_code = #{request.industryCode}, salary_growth_scenario = #{request.salaryGrowthScenario}, custom_salary_growth_rate = #{request.customSalaryGrowthRate} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lifecycle_event ( lifecycle_scenario_id, event_type, event_order, target_date, lifestyle_level, survey_data ) VALUES ( #{scenarioId}, 'MARRIAGE', #{eventOrder}, #{request.targetDate}, #{request.lifestyleLevel}, CAST(#{surveyData} AS JSON) )
mapper.select:
SELECT lifecycle_event_id, lifecycle_scenario_id, event_order, target_date, lifestyle_level,
JSON_UNQUOTE( JSON_EXTRACT(survey_data, '$.regionSido') ) AS region_sido,
JSON_UNQUOTE( JSON_EXTRACT(survey_data, '$.regionSigungu') ) AS region_sigungu,
CAST( JSON_UNQUOTE( JSON_EXTRACT(survey_data, '$.guestCount') ) AS UNSIGNED ) AS guest_count,
CASE WHEN JSON_EXTRACT(survey_data, '$.furnitureIncluded') = TRUE THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS furniture_included,
CASE WHEN JSON_EXTRACT(survey_data, '$.honeymoonIncluded') = TRUE THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS honeymoon_included,
CAST( JSON_UNQUOTE( JSON_EXTRACT(survey_data, '$.userContributionRate') ) AS DECIMAL(9,6) ) AS user_contribution_rate,
CAST( JSON_UNQUOTE( JSON_EXTRACT(survey_data, '$.familySupportAmount') ) AS DECIMAL(19,2) ) AS family_support_amount,
CAST( JSON_UNQUOTE( JSON_EXTRACT(survey_data, '$.customEstimatedCost') ) AS DECIMAL(19,2) ) AS custom_estimated_cost,
created_at, updated_at
FROM lifecycle_event
WHERE lifecycle_event_id = #{lifecycleEventId} AND event_type = 'MARRIAGE'
mapper.update:
UPDATE lifecycle_event
SET target_date = #{request.targetDate}, lifestyle_level = #{request.lifestyleLevel}, survey_data = CAST(#{surveyData} AS JSON)
WHERE lifecycle_event_id = #{lifecycleEventId} AND event_type = 'MARRIAGE'
